description: Find products in the agrodiler.com catalog (bearings, spare parts for agricultural machinery, agricultural machines) with the same search as the site search box. Use it first whenever the buyer names a bearing designation (6205-2RS, 32010, UC205, GOST 180205), a part number, a size (25x52x15), a brand or a machine model, or asks what is available or in stock; it is the only way to get the handles the other tools need. Do not use it to get the full details or the binding price of a product you already have a handle for (use get_product or quote). Returns up to limit items: handle, section (bearing, part, machine), title, designation, brand, dimensions_mm, in_stock, stock_qty, price_hint (catalog price in the market currency, not binding), url; plus match, total and note. lang selects the site and market: en (EU, EUR), uk or ru (Ukraine, UAH). match tells how well the query was matched: all_words = every word matched; some_words = only some words matched (check the items); none = nothing found, try another spelling or fewer words; "close_in_size" = the designation was decoded but is not in the catalog; items share d and D (other width or height) and are not exact substitutes. degraded true = number decoding was unavailable and only text search ran, so an empty result may be incomplete: retry later. Read-only: does not reserve stock or change anything.

lang.description: Site language and market (optional, default uk). uk = Ukrainian site and ru = Russian site: Ukraine market, prices in UAH, Nova Poshta delivery, no ship_to. en = English site (site root): EU market, prices in EUR excluding VAT, delivery to EU countries, ship_to is required for quote and place_order. Use the market of the buyer; the range, prices and product handles differ between markets, so keep the same lang across search_products, get_product, quote, cart_link and place_order.

limit.description: Maximum number of items in the reply, integer from 1 to 20. Optional, default 10. The reply is cut to this count; total shows how many matched.

query.description: Search text, 2 to 100 characters. Required. One of: a bearing designation ("6205-2RS", "32010", "UC205"; a GOST number such as "180205" is converted to ISO), a part number, a size in mm as "d x D x B" ("25x52x15"), a brand with a number ("SKF 6205", "FAG 32010"), a machine model or series ("DEFT 1,8"), or a product name. Spaces and case do not matter ("6205 2rs" = "6205-2RS"). Put only the search words here, not a sentence.

section.description: Optional filter by catalog section, default any. any = all sections; bearing = rolling bearings; part = spare parts for agricultural machinery; machine = agricultural machines (implements). The filter is applied to the matches of query, so it only removes other sections from the result.

name: search_products
title: Search agrodiler.com catalog
